item.title: Padres minor league coach freed from ICE custody, family confirms
item.description: A Padres minor league coaching coordinator detained by federal immigration officers in Texas has been released on bond, according to his family.

item.title: Second witness in Houston ICE shooting ordered released
item.description: A second witness to a fatal shooting by a federal immigration agent in Houston has been ordered released after over a month in detention.

item.title: Democrats launch new legal challenge to Trump postal election plans
item.description: Congressional Democrats and voting rights groups filed new challenges Tuesday against President Trump's proposals for postal service involvement in elections.
